We're working on a bug fix.  There isn't a workaround that I'm aware of.  You will need to reindex this data to a new index.

issue.title: Validate that fields are defined only once.

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
There are two ways that a field can be defined twice:
- by reusing the name of a meta mapper in the root object (`_id`, `_routing`,
  etc.)
- by defining a sub-field both explicitly in the mapping and through the code
  in a field mapper (like ExternalMapper does)

This commit adds new checks in order to make sure this never happens.

Close #15057

body: Delaying to 2.2.0: I'm on the fence to put such a change in a bugfix release.
@krisb78 the ability to embed metafields in the source of a document has been removed.  It required double parsing of the document (once on the coordinating node and once on the data node)
